descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S07a Where the pad and the sheet show: Quick Dictation in Hospital, absent in Nursing Home even mid-dictation; the Rounding Sheet hidden with the flag off

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Quick Dictation is Hospital only and is absent in Nursing Home. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 8)
  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 5; TFA-92582 step 5; TFA-92583 AC 4)
  • T3 Quick Dictation is the pad only: the separate Rounding Sheet view (patients with open tasks, today's assigned compartments, 'Needs patient') is hidden, not deleted, so it can be turned back on. (TFA-92583 AC 5; TFA-92583 AC 4; TFA-92583 AC 1)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Tim's chromium tests on a build with VITE_SHOW_ROUNDING_SHEET unset (default): Hospital list with the pad open and text typed, a care-context user, a patient with an open task

When Switch to Nursing Home with the pad open; open /rounding/sheet directly; walk every rounding-list navigation control

Then Quick Dictation visible in Hospital before the switch, absent in Nursing Home (no dialog, button or title); what was typed before the switch is kept on the server; /rounding/sheet lands on /rounding with no 'Rounding Sheet' heading; the list has no 'Rounding Sheet' button

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: title /Quick Dictation/ visible on /rounding before the switch, dialog / button / title count 0 on /snf (U8); quickDictation:list equals the typed text (U4); URL /rounding and heading count 0 for /rounding/sheet, getByTitle(/Rounding Sheet/) toHaveCount(0) on the list (T3, hidden). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S07a is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the triage is about a test issue and the result shown here is a full pass, so its status is kept.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92582 ready for qa; TFA-92583 ready for qa

Nothing is wrong for the physician (Quick Dictation shows in Hospital and not in Nursing Home, and the Rounding Sheet is hidden); our own 9/30 test timed out because the full-screen pad covers the Hospital/Nursing Home switch.

Evidence: Lane A, quick-dictation.spec.ts: test out of date (one of the six). Bisected 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248 on an isolated stack: no regression. All three navigation.spec.ts tests pass. Fix: close the pad before the switch.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

The out-of-date app test (e2e/quick-dictation.spec.ts) is a separate fix. The run's own result was drift; its evidence is below.

Result: failed in matrix/TC-04.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Test out of date (local) — the test is out of date, the product is right; not a product failure.

  • quick-dictation.spec.ts: Our own test from 9/30: the Quick Dictation pad is full screen and covers the Hospital / Nursing Home switch, so clicking the switch times out. The product is right; the test needs fixing.

Bisected on an isolated stack over 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248: 5d83248 brought no regression.

Existing specs:

  • navigation.spec.ts [chromium] — the rounding sheet and tasks screens open with the census on them — expected
  • navigation.spec.ts [chromium] — every rounding-list navigation control reaches its destination — expected
  • navigation.spec.ts [chromium] — offers only Hospital and Nursing Home and remembers the selection — expected
  • quick-dictation.spec.ts [chromium] — Quick Dictate is not in Nursing Home, even when the pad was open at the switch — unexpected
